name: recovery-probe
description: Test whether web and Electron desktop apps show the right data.
author: Bojan Kovachki

scripts.test:browser: npm run build --silent && node --test test/recovery.integration.test.mjs test/discovery.integration.test.mjs test/discovery-calibration.integration.test.mjs test/attach.integration.test.mjs test/refresh.integration.test.mjs test/observe.integration.test.mjs test/observe-queue.integration.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:core && npm run test:package && npm run test:browser && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:repair && npm run test:guided && npm run test:ipc && npm run test:ci-example
scripts.demo:browser: npm run build --silent && node bin/recovery-probe.mjs --demo --out artifacts/browser-demo.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run test:core && npm run test:package && npm run test:ipc
scripts.test:repair: npm run build --silent && node --test test/repair.test.mjs test/repair.integration.test.mjs test/web.integration.test.mjs
scripts.test:guided: npm run build --silent && node --test test/guided-start.test.mjs test/guided-start.integration.test.mjs
scripts.test:ipc: npm run build --silent && node --test test/ipc-probe.test.mjs test/ipc-control.test.mjs test/ipc-observation.test.mjs test/visibility.test.mjs test/refresh.test.mjs test/observe.test.mjs test/observation-report.test.mjs test/report-template.test.mjs test/observe-features.test.mjs
scripts.test:ipc:electron: npm run build --silent && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/ipc.electron.test.mjs test/observe.electron.test.mjs test/observe-queue.electron.test.mjs
